response.rationale: Sickle cell disease with sunburst lesions and ischemic macular whitening, plus OCT showing middle retinal layer atrophy, is classic for sickle cell retinopathy. CRAO is excluded by absent cherry-red spot and normal arteriolar filling; diabetic retinopathy lacks diabetes history and typical neovascularization.

rejected.why: No cherry-red spot and normal retinal arteriolar filling contradict central retinal artery occlusion.
No diabetes history or typical diabetic retinopathy features; sickle cell disease is the primary etiology.
